references.text: God set apart all the firstborn in Israel for Himself, which forms the basis for the Levites later being taken in place of the firstborn.
The command to dedicate all firstborn, both humans and animals, to the Lord, whom the Levites now replace.
The Lord explains the principle that the Levites are taken in place of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
Reiteration of the command to take the Levites in place of the firstborn, and the Levites' livestock in place of the Israelites' firstborn livestock.
Confirmation that the Levites are given to the Lord in place of all the firstborn in Israel.
The law concerning firstborn sons and firstborn animals that are to be given to the Lord.
Rules regarding the redemption of firstborn humans and animals, showing their connection to the role of the Levites.
Reference to the assembly of the firstborn in heaven, which relates to the special status of the firstborn in Israel.
